notes.title: 🧟 Deadwalker Chronicles is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello, and welcome to a strategic survival trial in a collapsing world.

We're a very small indie team, and Deadwalker Chronicles is our first attempt at blending single-player deckbuilding, survival, and mission-driven gameplay.

In this game, you will:

[list]
[*] Build your deck to face ever-changing missions, crises, and enemies
[*] Switch between Exploration Mode and Stealth Mode to survive smarter
[*] Make tough decisions with limited resources as the world around you falls apart
[/list]

🔧 Currently in Early Access, you can already experience the full core gameplay:

[list]
[*] Dynamic encounter system combining Mission, Zombie, Danger, and Location decks
[*] Six card types with strategic synergy (Action, Energy, Companion, Equipment, etc.)
[*] A dual-mode system that adds tactical depth to every situation
[/list]

🎯 If you're ready to dive in:
▶ Play through a full mission and feel the pressure
▶ Found any thoughts, feedback, or bugs? Let us know in the comments or join our Discord!
▶ If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam — every one of them means a lot to our small team.

📣 Join Our Discord
We’ve also opened a bilingual (English & Chinese) developer Discord community.
Share your feedback, screenshots, thoughts — or just drop by for a chat.

🎧 Discord Link:
👉 [url=https://discord.gg/6azJgfPUk9]Black Phoenix Studio Official Discord[/url]

Thank you again for reading,
and may you walk farther than yesterday in this land of the dead.
